model_output.rationale: 835 denies both lines CO-29/N211 as untimely. But the 277CA for trace TRC75364521 is dated 2025-01-27, eight days after the 2025-01-19 DOS, with no A3/A7 rejection — the claim was submitted and acknowledged well inside any commercial filing window. The defect is the payer's receipt date, not late filing: appeal with the acceptance report. CO bars patient billing; the claim as billed is correct, so no corrected claim.

root_cause.explanation: Both lines denied CO-29 / N211 for DOS 2025-01-19. The 277CA dated 2025-01-27 for the same trace TRC75364521 shows the claim was submitted and acknowledged eight days after DOS, with no A3/A7 rejection category.

next_action.detail: Appeal to Liberty Bell Health Plans disputing the receipt date. Attach the 277CA acknowledgement dated 2025-01-27 (trace TRC75364521, $138.62) as proof of submission inside the filing window. Do not rebill and do not bill the patient — group code CO.

citations.rule: CARC 29 + N211; acceptance report inside window → appeal the receipt date, not write-off
CO = provider liability, never bill patient; claim data right, determination wrong → appeal
